I can help you with that, but I need a little more information to give you the right recipe. 

Could you tell me:
1. **What part of the chicken are you cooking?** (e.g., whole chickens, breasts, thighs, or wings)
2. **How are you cooking them?** (e.g., roasting in the oven, grilling, frying, or slow cooking)
3. **What flavor profile are you looking for?** (e.g., lemon herb, BBQ, spicy, or plain)

Once I have those details, I can provide a full recipe and help you calculate the cooking times!

function.name: recipe_calculator_calculate_time
function.description: Calculates the time to cook a recipe based on weight and per unit time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

weight.description: The weight of the item to be cooked. This is a float type value.

per_unit_time.description: The time required to cook per unit weight.

unit_of_time.description: Unit of time, such as minutes or hours. Default is minutes.
